_about: Invented sample of an optional story bank, in the format produced by linkedin-story-interviewer. This skill only reads it; it works without one. All people and companies are fictional.

entries.title: Kickoff call dropped for small accounts
entries.detail: Removed the kickoff call for accounts under 50 seats in 2025. No complaints; larger accounts kept a 20-minute version because procurement wanted a named contact.

figure.measures: threshold below which the kickoff call was removed

entries.title: Weekly status email stopped
entries.detail: Sent a weekly status email to every client for four years. Stopped in January 2026; three of roughly sixty clients noticed.
entries.before: Weekly status email to all clients

entries.title: Clinic group that churned over invoicing
entries.detail: A multi-site clinic group left after a credit-note error. Details not yet confirmed with the account lead.

sample_lines: The ritual that survives longest is the one that reassures the vendor.
